source_statements.source_statement: Execute Issue #18 first, then automatically continue Issue #20.
Resolve REQ-20260624-028 by creating a new narrowly scoped execution run from current master without reopening the terminal final-release run.

Perform read-only production reconciliation for all relevant uploaded class jobs, including jobs 64-74 if they exist, without transcript bodies, private student details, secrets, or raw credentials in reports.

Trace each candidate through source discovery, intake job creation, file read, transcription, parsing, structured output, student matching, class-session linkage, persistence, read models, deduplication, and retry/backfill eligibility.
Produce a deterministic no-write dry-run row-level plan with target model, operation, source identifier, changed fields, before/after summary, confidence, idempotency key, and rollback method.
Set safe_to_apply=true only if all listed ambiguity, scoping, row plan, idempotency, duplicate, rollback, UI read-model, focused/full test, secret audit, and discrepancy gates pass.
Do not apply production writes in this issue; do not execute APPLY_GUARDED_CLASS_BACKFILL or mutate production records.

Add or run tests proving parsing, persistence mapping, ambiguity exclusion, duplicate idempotency, repeat dry runs, workspace scoping, UI read-model agreement, failure visibility, no-write mode, and secret/transcript exclusion.
Complete Issue #18 first under existing no-write guardrails, post terminal evidence, close or park its run correctly, then let the control tower create the Issue #20 parent run.
